cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told the committee I won't chair another year. You remember how I taught you to say no without a paragraph of excuses? I finally managed it myself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. Could you stay until we find someone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Listen to the whole answer. We practised that too. I spent an hour in your car getting those two sentences out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No extra paragraph. That's what I worked so hard to leave out. Could you tell them I said no, and tell me you know what that took?
